Container.Name: floppy
Container.Overview:
Floppy is a self-hosted, all-in-one media tracker: movies, TV, anime, manga, books, comics, games, board games, music, and podcasts in one library, history, and set of stats. A broader alternative to Trakt, Letterboxd, and TV Time.
Requires a reachable Redis instance (used for caching and as the Celery broker). This is not bundled - run a Redis container on this same Unraid server (for example redis:8-alpine) with port 6379 published to the host. REDIS_URL defaults to host.docker.internal, which resolves to this server automatically, so no IP address needs to be entered - just make sure Redis' port is published to the host and matches the port in REDIS_URL. SQLite is used by default; PostgreSQL is supported via the DB_* variables. Set SECRET to a long random string before first run. See the README for the full environment variable list: https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy#configuration-and-deployment
Container.Requires: A reachable Redis instance (cache + Celery broker). Not bundled - run a Redis container on this same Unraid server with port 6379 published to the host. REDIS_URL defaults to host.docker.internal:6379, which resolves to this server automatically.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Floppy web UI listens on.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database and local app data.

Config.Name: SECRET
Config.Description: Long random string used as the Django secret key. Required.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: URL of a reachable Redis instance, used for caching and as the Celery broker. Defaults to this same server via host.docker.internal - just run a Redis container here with port 6379 published to the host. Change the port if you published Redis on a different one. Required.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used for scheduling and displayed dates.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Allow new account sign-ups. Set to False after creating your account.

Config.Name: DEMO_ACCOUNT_ENABLED
Config.Description: Provision the public demo/demodemo account after migrations. Leave False unless you want it.

Config.Name: TMDB_API
Config.Description: TMDB API key for movie/TV metadata. Optional but recommended.

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: PostgreSQL host. Leave blank to use SQLite instead.

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name (only used when DB_HOST is set).

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user (only used when DB_HOST is set).

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password (only used when DB_HOST is set).

Config.Name: DB_PORT
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port (only used when DB_HOST is set).

Config.Name: URLS
Config.Description: Public URL if using a reverse proxy, e.g. https://floppy.yourdomain.com

Config.Name: ADMIN_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the Django admin interface at /admin/.

Config.Name: WEB_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Gunicorn worker processes.

Config.Name: GUNICORN_THREADS
Config.Description: Gunicorn threads per worker.

Config.Name: DEBUG
Config.Description: Enable Django debug mode. Leave False in production - it slows every request.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as.
